hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-black

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mobile-first, easy tapping, highly readable. Generous internal padding.
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: min-h-[48px] min-w-[48px] for all interactive elements
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Single column on mobile, bento/tetris inspired rigid grid on desktop.

buttons.primary: rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground px-6 py-4 font-semibold shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.ghost: rounded-md border-2 border-foreground/20 bg-transparent px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center justify-center transition-colors hover:border-primary active:scale-95

cards.style: bg-white border border-border shadow-sm rounded-xl p-6 md:p-8

header.mobile: h-16 border-b border-border bg-white flex items-center justify-between px-4 sticky top-0 z-50
header.desktop: h-20 border-b border-border bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-between px-8 sticky top-0 z-50
header.note: Avoid backdrop-blur-xl as it lags low-end phones. Use solid white or very light blur.

navigation.mobile_bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 inset-x-0 z-40 bg-white border-t border-border grid grid-cols-3 h-[60px] pb-safe

animations.philosophy: Hardware-accelerated, lightweight, respectful of low-end 3G devices.
rules: Use CSS transforms (translate, scale) and opacity only.
Avoid Math.pow/JS loops for counters; use lightweight CSS keyframes or raw text.
Disable complex enter animations on mobile; prefer simple fade-ins.

image_urls.description: Golden justice scales on a desk

media.optimization: Use WebP or AVIF. Lazy load all images below the fold. Max height 80vh on mobile.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet minimum 4.5:1 ratio against background. Brand color #0B192C easily passes.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor `routes/index.tsx` to optimize for mobile and low-end devices.
Replace heavy blur headers with solid backgrounds or minimal blurs.
Ensure all buttons/links have a minimum tap area of 48x48px (e.g., using `py-3 px-4` or `min-h-[48px]`).
Replace JS-heavy `requestAnimationFrame` counters with simpler IntersectionObserver CSS transitions, or just static numbers if performance drops.
Upgrade fonts to Playfair Display (Headings) and IBM Plex Sans (Body).
Restructure the 'TrustStrip' into a clean 2x2 or 2x3 grid on mobile to save space and reduce clutter.
Use data-testid on all key CTAs (e.g., data-testid='hero-counselling-button').
Ensure the bottom mobile bar has distinct, large touch targets with icons.
For the 'Air1Story', keep the image but use standard opacity fade on hover instead of heavy grayscale transitions which might drop frames on mobile.
